import trimesh, numpy as np
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
a=trimesh.load('checks/assembly/model.assembly.f07e2875.stl')
b=trimesh.load('checks/assembly/model.assembly.07b3764e.stl')
ta=cKDTree(a.vertices); tb=cKDTree(b.vertices)
d,i=tb.query(a.vertices); j=np.argmin(d); print('body vertex near lid',d[j],a.vertices[j],b.vertices[i[j]])
d2,i2=ta.query(b.vertices); j2=np.argmin(d2); print('lid vertex near body',d2[j2],b.vertices[j2],a.vertices[i2[j2]])
# print smallest few lid vertices
o=np.argsort(d2)[:12]
for k in o: print(round(float(d2[k]),3), b.vertices[k])
